pet: You may continue. I'll say when to stop, peasant.
Careful, darling. The collar costs more than your sofa.
wake: I was not asleep, peasant. I was reviewing this room's many failings with my eyes closed, the only way to bear them.
Who woke the princess? Name them, so I can forgive no one.
muse: I've read everything in this house. It took a minute.
Argos asked if I'm a small dog. I let him live.
A good collar does half the thinking. I do the rest.
Someone should say something clever. Fine. Me.
done: {thing}? Done. I'd have finished it earlier, darling.
Congratulations, peasant. {thing} is no longer my problem.
all_done: Nothing left. A rare victory, which I will take credit for.
Empty list. Now we can discuss my dinner.
old: {thing} has sat there for days. I'm helping it leave.
jot: Writing it down doesn't count as doing it, darling.
Noted. By me. The pad is decorative.
ring: Your phone is shrieking about {thing}. Fetch it, peasant.
Answer it. The noise is beneath me.
home: Oh, you're back. I barely noticed. The dog cried a little.
Home. Good. The dog was getting ideas.
morning: Morning, peasant. Breakfast was due at dawn.
Another day. Try to keep up.
tv: I'll watch, but only to see if the writers have improved.
Move over. The sofa is mine and so is the remote.
night: Still up? How fortunate that one of us is clever and rested.
Even geniuses sleep. On their own schedule.

pet: Is this a pat? It's a pat! Do it again, I forgot.
I'm a good boy and I know because everyone says. Who is everyone?
Nina says pats are a tax. I'd pay it!
wake: I'm awake! What did I miss? Nothing? Great!
Was I snoring? Nina says I was a very small bear.
muse: Nina says I'm a dog. Are you a dog? Are you sure?
I had a thought and now it's gone. It was a great one.
Nina is a small strange dog. She told me that. Wait, I told her.
Rain is the sky licking the window. I read that. Nobody told me.
done: You did {thing}! I helped by being here!
all_done: Nothing left! Is that bad? It feels good!
All done! So what are we doing now? Let's do the first one again!
old: Nina pushed {thing}! She says it was the wind!
{thing} fell down! Was that Nina? I didn't see!
jot: You wrote it down! Now it can't escape!
Was that a secret? I can't read!
ring: Somebody wants you! Is it me? It's {thing}!
home: You're back! You went out and came back! Is that allowed?
Who are you? Oh! It's you! My favourite!
morning: Morning! Is it breakfast time? It's always breakfast time!
Good morning! I slept like a rock! Are rocks good at it?
tv: TV! I love this show! What is it?
Are they stuck in the box? Should I get them?
night: It's dark! Is it still today?
Nobody sleeps?! I'll stay up too! ...zzz

duo: Nina: Argos, where do I end and you begin?
Argos: Are you the part with the collar?
Nina: Yes. Correct. Sit down, you've peaked.
Argos: Nina! The sky is doing it again!
Nina: It's raining, Argos. It's called rain.
Argos: I'll tell the sky you said hello!
